Synopsis:
A weary gravekeeper, absolutely exhausted at having to bury so many bodies in recent days. Would be good to have her have typical gallows humour, but be relatively kindhearted and helpful underneath it (though relatively unimportant) She will exclusively hang around the gravekeeper's house, and likely either be found sat and resting or just idly milling around a small area.Important topics:- Where you can find a shovel- Killings in Baldur's Gate (with a branch for if it's solved)- (When you've encountered them) Kobold Looters- Something to chastise the player if they've gone around digging up graves themselves, probably a HasMet alt?

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_Gravekeeper.json: Valmorba is the tired gravekeeper who stays by her little house beside the cemetery, usually sitting or idly pacing; she hides her kindness under weary, gallows‑humour remarks. Lately she's been burying far too many bodies, so she can identify specific plots (for example, M. Kurwin beneath the great willow) and will repeat a curt condolence when she recognises a returning visitor. Players can ask her for a shovel — she'll either lend one or tell you where she keeps hers — but she’ll scold you if you’ve been digging up graves yourself (alternate lines when she’s already met you). She also has lines about the recent killings in Baldur’s Gate (with different branches if the murders have been solved) and may acknowledge local trouble like kobold looters if you’ve encountered them.
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_KelemvorPriestess.json: Mortach Scyre, Priestess of Kelemvor, is a kind and gentle older woman (who will also not hestitate to beat your ass). She can come across a little morbid, but that's simply because she is completely at peace with death in a way very few people are. She is like the shephard of the graveyard - guiding and offering help where needs be.In this dialogue, she reacts to the things you've done to help people around the graveyard (and also to chastise you in the case of Nina, if you help her raise her brother from the dead)
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_AD_GraveKurwin.json: Simple grave narration. In Act 1, you may have found a letter to Nine-Fingers on a courier note. The note said, 'If you want your money, dig up the grave of M Kurwin. That'll settle my debt.'
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_BereavedMother.json: A mother that recently lost his child and has come to the graveyard with her husband to get a specially made coffin. Very dark, but gives the player a tiny sidequest they can complete to feel good about themselves (perhaps?)
- LOW_KurwinCoffin_KoboldLooter.json: Automatically initiated dialogue after players bash/prise open a coffin with Bugthimble, a tetchy and mistrustful Kobold, just trying to live her best life looting the coffin and the nasty adventurers dug her upt! She wears a face covering helmet.Players have either dug here expecting to find "Enough valuables to settle matters between us" as the note they found said (Tough letter, found on the Courier by Scratch) or just decided to dig up a grave for fun.
